book.name: Afisus
book.title: Pwoo ɗe Pool ran nen Afisus Mo

content: Ɗak Ɗe Pool CìnmBǝ Gurum Mo
A mbǝ ɗesǝ, ɓe wen Pool, an a shishoot mbǝ Kristi Jesu, mbǝ wun nen ɗe baa wun a nen Yahudi mo kas.
Azeen-nzeen wu man nee, nɗǝǝn ɗeret Naan, ɓe wur shin ɗak ɗesǝ nǝ nwen, mbǝkǝ nghan cìn ɗi mbǝ wun.
Naan wur woo mbii ɗesǝsok mo nwen ɗewur kǝ ten sat nǝ wuɗin ncìn nwen. Wen kǝn ran pwoo nwun lee nkaa nǝ.
Katɗang wu tang mbii ɗe ghan kǝn ran nǝ, ɓe wun mmanshii mman fen, nkaa mbii ɗesǝsok mǝ Kristi.
Gyet nyam, ɓe baa mo woo mbii ɗesǝsok nǝ mo ngurum mo kas, amma yaksǝ ɓe Naan wur kǝ woo nǝ agaak pee jeplep Jesu Kristi mo, kǝ nensatpwoo Naan ɗeɓang mo, shi Riin wur ɗeɓang.

Mbii ɗesǝsok nǝ a nee, nen ɗe baa mo a nen Yahudi mo kas, yaksǝ nɗǝǝn pwoo ɗeret nǝ, ɓe mo kat ɗeret mǝ Naan ashak kǝ nen Yahudi nǝ mo. Kǝzak yaksǝ, ɓe nen ɗe baa mo a nen Yahudi mo kas, mo ɗee a mbii ɗemǝndong. Mo mak sekop nɗǝǝn mbii ɗe Naan wur kǝ ten cweer nǝ, nwur gam nǝ nɗǝǝn Kristi.
A mbee pwoo ɗeret ɗesǝ, ɓe Naan wur nle kǝ ghan ɗee a ngucìn ɗak wur, nciit kǝ zuum ɗeret mǝ yit naajeel wur ɗewur kǝcin nwen, ɗe nǝ nkaa cìn ɗak nɗǝǝn ɓal wur.
Koo ɗe ghan a ɗetaakat met jir nɗǝǝn nen Naan mo, amma Naan wur cin ɗak ɗesǝ nǝ nwen, ɗe nǝ satpwoo ɗeret nǝ mbǝ nen ɗe baa mo a nen Yahudi mo kas. Pwoo nkaa long Kristi ɗe baa nǝ kǝ peekyes kas.
Kǝzak, mbǝkǝ nghan le kǝ gurum mo manshii mbii ɗesǝsok mǝ Naan mo ɗi, ɗe Naan ɗewur le mbii mo nɗǝǝn nyil nǝ jir, ɓe wur kǝ ten sok mbii ɗesǝ nǝ mbee ɓit mo ɗes.
Pan wur ɗesǝ nǝ, yaksǝ nɗǝǝn nendǝm nɗang wur mo, ɓe ɗeɗes mǝ seen wur nǝ ɗee agaak nɗǝǝn ar mo shini-shini, pǝ nenlep Naan mo kǝ iiko ɗe mo nɗǝǝn ɗengnaan
Nciit-nciit kǝ mbii ɗe Naan wur kǝ ten sat nee, wuɗin ncìn nǝ shindǝm ngaa-ngaa, ɗewur gam nǝ nɗǝǝn ɓalkaa fun ashak kǝ Kristi Jesu Daa fun.
Kǝ shinzeen fun nɗǝǝn wur, ɓe mu katɓal mpǝtuup, kǝ mu dǝm ɗe ntoom Naan, baa a shi kǝǝrmuut kas.
Wen kǝn ɗang pǝ wun, taji kwak fuu mo murep kas, mbǝɗe jir shawaajeel ɗe an nkaa shwaa nǝ a mbǝ wun. Shwaajeel fen nǝ kǝkoop nǝ pee wun ɗi.
Ɗangnaan mBǝ Nen Afisus Mo
A mbǝmǝnǝ, ɓe an kǝn kurum ntoom puun,
a mbǝ wur, ɓe koo a weyi ɗe mo nɗǝǝn ɗengnaan kǝ ɗe mo nɗǝǝn nyil ɗesǝ moo kat sǝm wur.
Wen kǝn ɗang pǝ Naan nɗǝǝn long wur ɗeɗes, mbǝkǝ wur shin iiko ɗe nwun nɗǝǝn Riin wur. Mbǝkǝ nwun katɓal ɗe nɗǝǝn pǝtuup fuu mo.
Mɓe kǝ Kristi wur tong nɗǝǝn pǝtuup fuu mo, mbǝɗe wu shinzeen wur. Wu shamseen, kǝ nwun ɗar nkaa kuk ɗe nǝ a wal.
Mbǝkǝ nwun, ashak kǝ nen Naan mo, ɓe wu man kaam, kǝ shwal, kǝ wurang, kǝ jurum mǝ wal mǝ Kristi ɗi.
Kǝzak, mbǝkǝ wu man wal mǝ Kristi ɗe nǝ met nkoor man mo jir, mbǝkǝ wu gam ɗi kǝ man Naan nɗǝǝn pǝtuup fuu mo.
Yaksǝ, pee wur, ɗewur kǝ iiko ɗe nǝ cìn ɗak nɗǝǝn mun, met mbii ɗe mu mak ɗang mo, koo pan ɗe mo nɗǝǝn pǝtuup fun.
Ɗeɗes nǝ ɗee a mǝ Naan nɗǝǝn nendǝm ndang wur mo, kǝ nɗǝǝn Kristi Jesu mbǝ pǝ mo jir, yool yaksǝ kǝ, har ngaa-ngaa. Nǝ a kǝsǝ.
